name: Design and Synthesis of Molecules and Materials
description: Selectivity in organic synthesis: chemo, regio stereo and enantioselectivity. Diversity-oriented synthesis: concept of forward-synthetic analysis, appendage diversity, skeletal diversity, stereo-chemical diversity, complexity and diversity. Asymmetric synthesis: use of chiral catalysts, chiral auxilairies, organocatalysis, chiron approach and N-heterocyclic carbenes; synthesis and characterization of organometallic compounds relevant to organometallic catalytic reactions; 3d transition metal complexes of macrocyclic and non-macrocyclic ligands for small molecule activation reactions; chemistry of main group elements in synthesis, catalysis, and biomedical and materials. Research; introduction to metal-oxo clusters; iso-polyanions, hetero-polyanions, synthesis, structure and pH stability of polyanions, polyanions-based catalysts; photocatalysis and electrocatalysis. Porous materials; zeolites, metal organic frameworks, covalent organic frameworks, and porous organic polymers, structure and property of different inorganic semiconductors; wolframite, shellite, spinel, preovskite, layer double hydroxide, oxy-halides, metal chalcogenides, metal pnictides.
